name: glyhub_GPST000214_N_AML_CellLines
title: N-glycan profiles of 21 acute myeloid leukemia cell lines
description: Complete 68-feature released N-glycan fractional-abundance matrix in 21 AML cell lines from Integrated N- and O-Glycomics of Acute Myeloid Leukemia (AML) Cell Lines.
details: Source assay is the complete individual-glycan block only; following glycan-feature/derived-trait rows are not molecular features. Author-imputed values of 0.01 replacing zeros are preserved exactly as published; this curation does not reverse or add imputation. Only actual quantitative zero values become NA. No renormalization is applied. One source profile column represents each cell line; biological/technical replicate status of the main table is not specified by its headers and is left unknown. The RSD_MOLM-14 sheet is retained as auxiliary variability data rather than appended: biological rep1 overlaps technical replicates, and N-glycan technical and biological panels have different feature denominators. Isomer suffixes are preserved without collapsing rows.
annotation: Counts follow the author legend: H=Hex, N=HexNAc, F=Fuc, S=NeuAc, P=phosphate, Su=sulfate. In typed composition, sulfate uses S and sialic acid uses NeuAc. Structures are not inferred from composition, retention order or mass.
